entities.text: Parashuram Bhajantri vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This petition is filed by the petitioner/accused under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with the following prayer:
"Wherefore, it is most humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to set aside the impugned order dated 20.08.2025 i.e., Annexure-F passed on application as filed by the petitioner under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. pending before the Hon'ble Court of II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad in Spl. S.C. No.38/2021 for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act,
2012 and allow the same above petition, in the interest of justice."
2. The petitioner being accused has filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. for recalling the witness PW-1 for further cross-examination.

entities.text: Court of II Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dharwad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The said application was rejected by the learned Sessions Judge on the ground that on an earlier occasion the petitioner has already filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C., and it was allowed and recalled witness PW-1 and subsequently the PW-1 was cross-examined.

Once again, the petitioner has filed the same application under Section NC: 2026:KHC-D:3574 HC-KAR 311 of Cr.P.C. to recall PW-1 for further cross-examination on the ground that the Advocate for the accused is changed.

The learned Sessions Judge by following the judgment of this Court passed in the case of Ramesh @ Ramappa and Another vs. State of Karnataka and Another, dated 16.10.2024, Criminal Petition No.201236/2024 has dismissed the application.

entities.text: Ramesh @ Ramappa and Another vs. State of Karnataka and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. The petitioner earlier has filed an application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. and got recalled the witness PW-1 and also cross-examined PW-1.
Thereafter, two and a half years, once again he has filed another application under Section 311 of Cr.P.C. for recalling the said witness PW1 and for making the further cross-examination.
This application is earlier rejected by the learned Sessions Judge by following the order passed by this Court stated above.
Therefore, there is no infirmity found in the order of the learned Sessions Judge.

Sd/-
